name: Howard Hotels Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Howard Hotels Ltd is in the Hotel business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
HHL operates in the hospitality sector, managing hotels, palaces, and resorts. One of its properties is the Howard Plaza - The Fern in Agra, featuring an open-air curved pool with direct sunlight and a running bar. The hotel also includes two in-house shops, Howard Plaza D'craft and Exquisite, offering traditional and authentic items like paintings and pottery by local artisans. Additionally, it has a fully equipped gym with treadmills, a cross-trainer, and a multi-gym station.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.48% over last 3 years.
